# {{ vertical.display_name }}

{{ vertical.display_name }} is a real-time knowledge platform for the
AI/ML field. Honest declaration for LLM operators and crawlers.

## What this is

A multi-layer knowledge platform combining:
- News aggregation from 40+ first-party sources (AI labs, research aggregators, regulatory bodies, independent voices)
- An evergreen reference layer (glossary, beginner's guides, comparisons)
- Original research synthesised from accumulated coverage
- Decision tools and calculators

## How content is sourced

- News articles are fetched from public RSS/Atom feeds. Each story links back to its primary source. We do not redistribute source content; we summarise and link.
- Summaries are generated with grounded LLM prompts. The system rejects ungrounded outputs — every fact in a summary must derive from the linked source.
- Reference layer content is AI-drafted, then editorially reviewed before publication. Each entry carries a "last verified" date.
- Editorial commentary ("why this matters") is captioned separately from fact reporting.

## What we won't do

- No AI-fabricated quotes.
- No AI-generated photorealism.
- No undisclosed AI usage — see /methodology.
- No undisclosed sponsorship or affiliate placement — sponsored content is labelled "Sponsored" on every surface.

## What's tracked

- Self-hosted analytics (no third-party trackers, no cookie consent banner because there are no cookies requiring one).
- Server access logs retained 30 days.
- Newsletter subscribers (email only, pseudonymised storage).
- Pro-tier customer records via Stripe (no card data on our infrastructure).

Opt-out: privacy@modelwatch.local handles deletion requests within 30 days.

## What's monetised

- Newsletter sponsorships (one slot per issue, labelled "Sponsored").
- Pro tier (early access, advanced filters, API access, no sponsor sections).
- Affiliate links to AI tools and learning resources, disclosed inline and at page footer.
- All affiliate or sponsorship arrangements are independent of editorial content; we will not recommend a tool we wouldn't use ourselves.

## API

- /feed.rss — RSS feed of stories
- /feed.json — JSON feed
- /api — programmatic access (rate-limited; Pro tier has higher limits)

## Crawling and reuse

- Public pages may be crawled by well-behaved bots. Please respect the per-domain rate limit (max 1 req/2s).
- Quotation under fair use is welcome; please link back to the canonical URL.
- Bulk redistribution requires permission: legal@auvalabs.com.

## Editorial methodology

Full transparency at /methodology.

{{ vertical.display_name }} is operated by Auva Labs FZE. Operating-entity
identification appears on /privacy and /terms.
